confidence_notes: June 2026 Numbeo data support the meal, cappuccino and draft beer estimates. Local menus and typical premiums over draft beer inform the cocktail and wine estimates. July lodging rates are modeled before taxes and fees. Both hostel estimates are especially uncertain given limited local supply. [June Numbeo snapshot via Expatica](https://www.expatica.com/us/cost-of-living/san-antonio-tx/), [Chris Madrid's bar menu](https://www.chrismadrids.com/bar-menu/), [Aguazul menu](https://aguazul.app/menu)
comparable_city_reasoning: Lodging estimates use South Texas pricing patterns and account for River Walk tourism and the supply of budget properties near the airport and along the interstates.
